summary.notes: Closed-form verification of the Theorem-3.3 mechanism on the paper's task-mixture class (linear vs degree-2 Hermite families, Definition 2.1): the mixture posterior concentrates on the true task and the Bayes-optimal mixture predictor converges to the true-family oracle, ratio(k) = excess_mix/excess_oracle >= 1 (Rao-Blackwell) decreasing to 1. The Transformer training experiment of Sec 4 needs GPU training and is out of CPU-audit scope; this verifies the Bayesian mechanism it demonstrates. Reviewer-provided reference implementation.
